news.title: Daily pass: 288 verified additions (R4295–R4582), 3 from the review list and 25 from the open queue
news.detail: Retry list first: all 77 leads retried; 3 promoted (R4295–R4297) — two ACI abstract-portal records for 1975 papers (Powers, "Freezing Effects in Concrete"; Browne and Cady, "Deicer Scaling Mechanisms in Concrete") whose pages now open, and an Indonesian-language fly-ash strength paper from its journal page. 111 leads stay on the review list (74 carried over, 13 new from discovery, 24 from the open queue). Open queue: the 49 KDOT/Kansas mix-design leads queued on Nov 21 were checked — 25 promoted (R4298–R4322; Kansas, Nebraska and Oklahoma DOT and FHWA reports, KCMMB 2026 specification, KDOT 2015 specifications via Wayback, ROSA P records via Wayback), 24 moved to the review list (KDOT PQL/special-provision documents that answer HTTP 403 with no archived copy, two TRID records). Discovery then added 260 verified sources for microcracking, mass concrete, portland cement, fibres, fly ash, HPC/UHPC, calcined clay, construction, failure/repair, regional supply, heavyweight concrete, masonry/white cement and RCC, with 66 records from backward and 29 from forward citation chases, 39 non-English records (English glosses) and 27 dated 2026. Mostly DOI/abstract or record-page level, not full-text reviews. Review list: https://xxdccole.github.io/Type1L-Index/review/

gap: Daily pass 2026-11-22: additions are registry/catalogue/record-page verified (84 abstract-level, 150 DOI metadata only, 35 record pages or PDFs read incl. Wayback copies, 6 library catalogue records, 13 public PDFs opened) — not full-text reviewed. 111 qualified leads remain on the review list (research/review-retry.md; https://xxdccole.github.io/Type1L-Index/review/): mainly the KDOT PQL and special-provision documents (ksdot.gov answers HTTP 403, no Wayback copy), TRID records, CNKI/CQVIP Chinese articles, Theseus (Cloudflare), J-GLOBAL (503) and unregistered DOIs. The Kansas/Nebraska/Oklahoma DOT items are report-level reads of the first pages only. The Type IL/PLC-specific KDOT sources remain thinly covered.

takeaways.microcracking: Nov 22 backfill: acoustic-emission crack classification, crack-pattern and mass-concrete restraint-stress papers, plus German- and Spanish-language cracking studies (R4396–R4580, 15 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.mass: Nov 22 backfill: adiabatic temperature rise, distributed temperature sensing and thermal-cracking control papers, the RILEM report on thermal cracking of massive structures, and German/Portuguese mass-concrete literature including the 1979 Kölnbrein dam article (R4507–R4532, 11 records). DOI/abstract level only.
